meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抛出研究问题，得到带引用、经质检的调研报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对某个问题做系统调研并要可核实的引用来源。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, QA-checked report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic investigation with verifiable citations.

howto.what: 用户明确要求深度研究时,Claude 会进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式:先自己拆解主题、组建研究小组并铺开搜索,对争议结论发起辩论、跑代码验证,最后交付每条结论都带引用或证据的报告。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞等触发词时接管。普通提问、调试会话不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我彻底调查这个主题,每条结论都要有引用
say.note: 会先拆解主题、组队并行搜索,再做辩论与验证

say.text: 对这个问题做一次深度研究,有争议的地方跑代码验证
say.note: 争议说法会被证明或推翻,再写入报告

say.text: 调查这个技术选型,给我一份带来源的深度报告
say.note: 团队分头查证后合成带引用的交付物

howto.what_en: When you explicitly ask for deep research, Claude enters ULW-RESEARCH mode: it scopes the topic itself, stands up a research team, fans out searches, debates contested claims, proves them with code, and delivers a report citing every claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use "ulw-research" or any "ulw" research wording. Ordinary questions and debugging sessions do not activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate this topic exhaustively, with a citation per claim
say_en.note: Scopes the topic, fans out a team, debates, then verifies

say_en.text: Run a deep research pass on this and verify contested claims with code
say_en.note: Contested claims get a code proof or are dropped

say_en.text: Do an ulw-research investigation of this tech choice and deliver a sourced report
say_en.note: Delivers a report where each claim carries a source
